statement: FPA revenue monotonicity for tCPA bidders (mu=1, no budget): Rev(M_A) >= Rev(M_B) whenever M_A refines M_B (Theorem 5.1).
method: Random stress test over calibrated coarse/refined model pairs; revenue computed as Rev(M)=sum_C w_C*max_i t_i*p_i,C.

non_refinement.description: Construct M_A NOT refining M_B; monotonicity no longer guaranteed -> Rev can decrease.

broken_calibration.description: Replace calibrated predictions with random values; Jensen step invalid -> Rev can decrease.
